privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Social Security Bronx
privacy.description: How Social Security Bronx handles data: no accounts, email only if you write, location only in your browser, and how Google ads and cookies work here.
privacy.html:
Last updated: November 3, 2026

Social Security Bronx (socialsecuritybronx.com) is an independent website about the Social Security offices in the Bronx, New York: addresses, hours, appointments and how to get things done. This page explains, in plain terms, what happens with your data when you use it. It describes what the site actually does; it is not copied from another site.

Who runs the site

The site is edited by Agustín Mendez, based in Pinamar, Argentina, who decides how it works and is responsible for the data described here. It is not an official website and has no relationship with the Social Security Administration (SSA) or any government agency. Contact: {{EMAIL}}.

What we collect

  • No accounts. There is no registration, login or newsletter, and no payment of any kind.
  • No forms that send data to us. Nothing you type on the pages is sent to us.
  • Email, if you write to us. If you email us, we receive your address and your message. We use them only to reply and, if you report an error, to correct the page. We keep the email in our mailbox for as long as it is useful for that and we never sell or share it.
  • Technical logs. Like any web server, the server that delivers the pages records technical data for each request (IP address, date and time, page requested, browser). These logs are used only for security and to keep the site working.

Services from other companies

Some parts of the pages load from other companies. When that happens your browser connects to them directly, and they receive at least your IP address:

  • Google Fonts (Google): the typefaces load from Google servers, which receive your IP address and browser details. Google Fonts does not set cookies. Google privacy policy.
  • cdnjs (Cloudflare): the icon set loads from this public library network, which receives your IP address and browser details. It does not set cookies. Cloudflare privacy policy.
  • Google Maps: the map frame loads on pages that show a map. Google receives your IP address and the place shown, and may set its own cookies under the Google privacy policy. Links that say "directions" open Google Maps in the same tab.
  • Cloudflare: visits pass through Cloudflare, which protects and speeds up the site. It processes your IP address and request details and, when it needs to check that a visit is not automated, may set a strictly necessary security cookie. Cloudflare privacy policy.
  • Google AdSense: the site may show ads served by Google AdSense. When ads are shown, Google uses cookies and similar technologies as described below. How Google uses information from sites that use its services.

Advertising

If ads are shown on this site, they will be served by Google AdSense. Google and its partners use cookies to show ads, measure them and limit how often you see the same one. If personalized ads are on, Google may use your visits to this and other sites to choose ads. You can turn personalized ads off in My Ad Center (also reachable through Google Ads Settings). Details: how Google uses information from sites that use its services and how Google uses cookies in advertising.

For visitors in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland, Google requires that personalized ads be shown only with consent collected through a certified consent tool. Without that consent, Google shows only non-personalized or limited ads. This site does not run a cookie banner of its own.

Cookies and local storage

The site itself does not set cookies. The site itself does not use local storage either. Cookies from Google (ads and, if shown, maps) and Cloudflare are listed with their purpose in our cookie policy, together with how to block or delete them.

Your rights

Several U.S. states, including California (CCPA as amended by the CPRA), Colorado, Connecticut, Virginia, Texas and others, give residents rights over their personal information: to know what is collected, to get a copy, to correct or delete it, and to opt out of its sale or of targeted advertising. We do not sell the emails or any other information we receive. Advertising cookies, when ads are shown, are placed by Google and may count as "sharing" for cross-context behavioral advertising under California law; you can opt out of that with the tools on our cookie policy page.

In practice, the only personal data we may hold about you is an email you sent us. Write to {{EMAIL}} to ask for a copy or to have it deleted and we will do it. For data processed by Google, use the tools linked above.

Children

The site is meant for adults dealing with the Social Security offices in the Bronx, New York: addresses, hours, appointments and how to get things done. It is not aimed at children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect their data.

Changes

If the site starts doing something new with data (for example, adding a form or a different ad provider), this page will be updated first and the date at the top will change. See also the terms of use, the about page and the contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Use | Social Security Bronx
terms.description: Terms of use of Social Security Bronx, an independent, unofficial site about Social Security offices in the Bronx.
terms.html:
Last updated: November 3, 2026

These terms apply to Social Security Bronx (socialsecuritybronx.com). By using the site you accept them. They are short because the site is simple: it publishes free information and does not sell anything.

What the site is

Social Security Bronx is an independent guide about the Social Security offices in the Bronx, New York: addresses, hours, appointments and how to get things done, edited by Agustín Mendez (Pinamar, Argentina). It is not an official website and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to the Social Security Administration (SSA) or any government agency. Official names and logos belong to their owners and are mentioned only to identify the services described.

Information, not official advice

Content is general information compiled from public official sources, with the source and date shown where possible. Addresses, hours, fees and requirements change without notice. Check with the official office or website before you travel, pay or submit anything. Nothing on the site is legal, financial or professional advice.

We do not process applications

We cannot book appointments, file applications, check the status of a case or take payments. Any page or person that asks you for money in the name of this site is not us.

Advertising

The site may show ads served by Google AdSense. Ads are marked as such and are chosen by Google, not by us. Showing an ad does not mean we recommend the advertiser.

Links to other websites

We link to official websites and, sometimes, to other useful pages. We do not control them and are not responsible for their content, availability or privacy practices.

Use of the content

You may read, print and share pages for personal use, and quote short parts with a link to the source page. Copying the site or large parts of it, or reusing it automatically, is not allowed. Official data remains the property of the bodies that publish it.

Errors and liability

We work to keep every page accurate and we correct errors when they are reported. Even so, we cannot guarantee that all information is complete or current. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for losses caused by relying on it. If you find a mistake, please tell us at {{EMAIL}}.

Changes

We may update these terms; the date at the top shows the current version. Related pages: privacy policy, cookie policy, about and contact.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy | Social Security Bronx
cookies.description: Which cookies and browser storage Social Security Bronx uses, by category: none of its own, Google ad cookies when ads are shown, and how to turn them off.
cookies.html:
Last updated: November 3, 2026

Cookies are small files a website stores in your browser. Local storage is a similar space in your browser that only the page can read. This page lists everything of that kind that can be used when you visit Social Security Bronx, grouped by purpose, and who sets it.

Summary

  • Necessary: the site does not need any cookie of its own to work. Cloudflare may set a security cookie in some cases.
  • Preferences: none.
  • Advertising: none at the moment. If ads are added, Google and its partners will set cookies to serve and measure them.
  • Analytics: none. The site does not use Google Analytics or any other tracking script.

Detail

CategoryNameSet byPurpose and duration
Necessary__cf_bm, cf_clearanceCloudflareSet only when Cloudflare needs to filter automated traffic. Up to 30 minutes (__cf_bm) or as set by the security check.
Third-party contentGoogle cookies such as NIDGoogle (Maps)Only when a Google map loads on a page. Remembers map preferences and protects against abuse. Up to 6 months.
AdvertisingGoogle cookies such as __gads, __gpi, __eoi, IDE, DSID, test_cookieGoogle and its ad partnersOnly if ads are shown. Serve ads, limit repetition, measure results and, with personalized ads on, choose ads based on your activity. From a few minutes up to 13 months.

Cookie names and durations are decided by each company and may change. Google publishes the current list in How Google uses cookies in advertising.

Fonts, icons and map tiles loaded from other servers (described in the privacy policy) do not set cookies, but those servers do receive your IP address.

How to control them

  • In your browser: you can block or delete cookies at any time: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge.
  • Google ads: turn off personalized ads in My Ad Center or Google Ads Settings. You will still see ads, but they will not be based on your activity.
  • Industry opt-out: WebChoices (Digital Advertising Alliance) lets you opt out of interest-based ads from many companies at once.
  • Blocking all cookies does not stop the site from working. Only maps from Google may need cookies to load correctly.

Visitors from the EEA, the UK and Switzerland

Google requires that, for visitors in those regions, personalized ads be shown only after consent collected through a certified consent tool. Without consent, Google serves non-personalized or limited ads, which still use cookies for frequency capping and fraud prevention. This site does not show a cookie banner of its own; if one appears for ads, it is the consent message required by Google.

Questions

Write to {{EMAIL}}. See also the privacy policy and the terms of use.
